section.catchline: Depository institution to release portion of amount subject to levy.
section.subsection: Subject to the other provisions of this section, a depository institution shall release the portion of the amount subject to a levy under this part that the commission may receive in accordance with Section 59-1-1710 from the depository institution.

On the first business day after the day on which the commission provides the notice described in Subsection 59-1-1710(3) to the depository institution, the depository institution shall release the lesser of the following:
the portion of the amount the commission may receive in accordance with Section 59-1-1710 from the depository institution; or the balance of the delinquent taxpayer's account on the first business day after the day on which the commission provides the notice described in Subsection 59-1-1710(3) to the depository institution minus: the $10 reimbursement to the depository institution described in Section 59-1-1713; and the fees that an account holder agreed to pay the depository institution to process a writ of garnishment in a deposit agreement.
